skills.name: open_input_bar
skills.description: Open the JARVIS textbar / multimodal input bar HUD when the user asks to open the textbar, input bar, or type, paste, attach, upload, or send text or files to JARVIS.

skills.name: close_input_bar
skills.description: Close the JARVIS textbar / input bar HUD when the user asks to close or dismiss it.
